proof: A successful canonical build and deterministic package validation seal the exact ZIP bytes against the full product, public asset, manifest, workspace, build, dependency, toolchain, production-environment, legal/generated-inventory, and packaging-owner closure. ci:build has no canonical producer capability.
rollback: Delete or omit the build proof and archive pair to force build and packaging.
collisionCheck: Reuse materializes one verified archive through an exclusive temporary file and never accepts an unrelated ci:build output.
